name: captured belt lines are not cleared
find: for _, line in ipairs(lines) do line.clear() end
replace: for _, line in ipairs({}) do line.clear() end

name: the final sweep captures nothing
find: for _, unit in ipairs(state.units) do capture_unit(job, state, unit, cache, seen, true) end
replace: for _, unit in ipairs({}) do capture_unit(job, state, unit, cache, seen, true) end

name: a cleared item that reappears is captured again
a straddling item does not merge its groups
find:
if owner ~= gi then
						join_groups(state, owner, gi)
replace:
if false then
						join_groups(state, owner, gi)

name: the census is not recorded for captured belts
the census is read after the lines are cleared
find:
if #lines_out > 0 or not sweeping then
		SourceCargoIntegrity.record(job.census, entity, { entity_id = entity_data.entity_id, specific_data = { items = lines_out } })
	end
	for _, line in ipairs(lines) do line.clear() end
replace:
for _, line in ipairs(lines) do line.clear() end
	if #lines_out > 0 or not sweeping then
		SourceCargoIntegrity.record(job.census, entity, { entity_id = entity_data.entity_id, specific_data = { items = lines_out } })
	end

name: the restore looks belts up by the global unit-number lookup, which belts do not support
a failed restore is retried blindly
a restore with unplaced items still clears the record
the unlock does not put cleared cargo back
the unlock proceeds when the cargo could not be put back
a transfer captures its belts in one callback
find: return job.destination_instance_id ~= nil and next(job.belt_entities or {}) ~= nil

find: return job.destination_instance_id ~= nil and next(job.belt_entities or {}) ~= nil
